title: Reviewer freeze-check wording names no parameter: prompt and tool description say "SHA-256 literal", the tool's field is expectedFingerprint, so a reviewer's first call can 422
outcome: Reviewer freeze-check wording names no parameter: prompt and tool description say "SHA-256 literal", the tool's field is expectedFingerprint, so a reviewer's first call can 422
acceptance: The delegated-child prompt text for Engram schema-1 freeze verification (src/delegations.rs) and TERMAL_REVIEW_FREEZE_TOOL_DESCRIPTION (src/review_freeze_api.rs) name the tool's arguments exactly as `manifestPath` and `expectedFingerprint`, and say the expected fingerprint is the parent's separately recorded 64-hex SHA-256 value
The tool's input schema is unchanged (no alias field such as expectedSha256 is accepted): additionalProperties stays false
A test pins that both texts name `expectedFingerprint` and `manifestPath`, and that every argument name they mention is a property of the published input schema
